**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

A texture of the host, by OpenGL name, that JOID samples without owning it.

## Description

Create it after the OpenGL backend is registered; JOID reads its size from OpenGL and never deletes it.

## Creation details

<a id="GlBorrowedTexture-factory-of"></a>

### of

`GlBorrowedTexture of(int texture)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Wraps the texture of that OpenGL name.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when no OpenGL render bridge is registered.

`GlBorrowedTexture of(IntSupplier texture)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Wraps the texture whose name the supplier returns, read again at each use, for a host that recreates its texture.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when no OpenGL render bridge is registered.
